column1: # The 818 rows the first page-2 sweep could not measure, re-asked — 2026-10-20.
# The first run (docs/page-two-2026-10-20.tsv) reported these as PAGE1_FAILED or
# NET_ERR, 569 of them `Connection refused` in its last 15%% across wholly
# unrelated hosts. This run used the same tool with three fixes:
#   * tools/jo_tls.py — Python's default TLS context refuses handshakes the
#     ENGINE completes (yamaguchi-opendata.jp: FAIL vs HTTP 200 at SECLEVEL=1,
#     verification still on, while the engine stores 102 records from it)
#   * LOCAL_EGRESS — `Connection refused` / `reset by peer` retried with a
#     back-off and, when they persist, reported as THIS ENVIRONMENT's limit
#     rather than as a reading about the source
#   * a record counter that no longer counts an ArcGIS polygon's coordinate
#     RING as records (21 features had read as 3,748) and no longer GUESSES a
#     count for a body it truncated (48 packages had read as 1,232)
# **654 of the 818 — 80%% — are healthy**, where the first run had written every
# WHAT WAS DONE WITH THE FINDINGS
#   LUCHTMEETNET_LKI    the bare path 302s and the redirect DROPS the page
#                       parameter, so every page came back as page 1: 100 of
#                       the 17,100 a 7-day window holds. Re-pointed at the full
#                       parameter set with a rolling six-hour {ago:} window ->
#                       604 of 604 across 8 pages. Its id_keys was wrong too,
#                       and invisible while it read one page: 100 records sit on
#                       17 distinct station_numbers, so the identity is the pair.
#                       2,000 of 2,628 at the 20-page default, disclosed every
#                       declares page_zero_based), but running it surfaced a
#                       DEAD id_keys the gate was not looking for: `sessionNumber`
#                       matched 0 of 12 records because the LDA API wraps scalars
#                       would store 5 of 12, because session numbers restart each
#                       parliament. Keyed on `_about` now, 12 distinct of 12.
#                       complete as they stand: 26, 97 and 1 records, the whole
# The 73 LOCAL_EGRESS rows are UNMEASURED FROM HERE, not broken: the hosts
# answer HTTP 000 through this container's proxy even one at a time, and the
# proxy names the cause itself (ws_closed_mid_exchange). A sweep run elsewhere
